io.lisp:7690-7692 (sink, when neither a full replay nor an F-row position applies)
  (t
   (setq acc (fnn-core 'fn-store-log-next-txid-step record acc))
   (push (fnn-octets record) kept))
io.lisp:7197-7198
  (fnn-core 'fn-store-sco-observed-count

io.lisp:7207-7208
  (let* ((s (second choice))

fix: Pass the count as a natural (or have ACL2 take the count). Learn S from the checkpoint before the scan and drop records below S in the sink, keeping only the suffix. If F-row-less state checkpoints can no longer occur under the one-format rule, delete this branch.
reviewer: The code path is as described. The final (t ...) branch at io.lisp:7690-7692 keeps every record. fnn-recover-log-from-state-checkpoint then builds an index list only so it can be counted (7197-7198), then takes the suffix with nthcdr (7207-7208). That branch is reached only when status is :ok and log-position is NIL. log-position comes from the F row's log slot (store-node-host.lisp:659-662), and the codec allows NIL (books/store-checkpoint-tables.lisp:367-376). However, every current host checkpoint writer rotates first and records a (K G) position: owner auto-publish at owner.lisp:5234, reclaim at owner.lisp:5657, store-level publish at io.lisp:3414, and the snapshot producer at snapshot-producer.lisp:533. fnn-log-rotate either returns a position or refuses. I could not find a producer of a position-less state checkpoint in the current format (with the no-migrations policy, no legacy stores should exist). The inefficiency is real, but whether any store can reach it could not be settled by reading.
scenario: A store whose state checkpoint carries no log position (status :ok, log-position NIL) opens by holding every record of every segment as octet vectors. Then it builds a second list of N fixnums only so ACL2 can count it, and finally discards the first S records via nthcdr. Peak open memory grows with the whole history, not with the suffix, which is the open-time allocation the PKT-823 and nursery comments (8369-8380) are trying to avoid.
title: The open over a state checkpoint keeps every record of the log, the covered prefix included, plus an index list just to count them
